summary: First Busey Corporation filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K on November 6, 2026, announcing that its board declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.515625 per depositary share on its 8.25% Fixed-Rate Series B Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The dividend is payable December 1, 2026, to holders of record as of November 16, 2026. Each depositary share represents a 1/40th interest in a preferred share. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special situation event.
